svg.title: AetherGrid cluster-wide data flow
svg.desc: Complete data flow across AetherGrid: job creation, best-fit scheduling, lease acquisition, dual execution paths (in-process WorkerExecutionLoop for dashboard-managed workers and the standalone scripts/run_agent.py process for agent-managed workers), reconciliation via the shared reclaim_job operation, PostgreSQL persistence, and the live event feed.
svg.text: ClusterTickService - background asyncio task, api.py lifespan, ticks every 1.0s
Every route requires a valid API key (AuthenticateApiKeyService). No unauthenticated path exists, including key issuance itself.
real subprocess.Popen, SIGTERM then SIGKILL on timeout
then JobExecutionService, identical subprocess, over the network
release lease -> save worker IDLE -> node.release()+save -> job.save(), in that order (ADR 0011/0033)
shared by both services above + CreateWorkerService (ADR 0039)
Job - back to QUEUED, or FAILED
retry consumed; FAILED outright once exhausted
every repository contract-tested identically across backends
Every service, entity, and background process below is traced from the real codebase, not a simplified model.
Execution - two independent paths, gated by Worker.managed_by
Reconciliation - same tick, every worker/lease/node checked
Both sent by scripts/run_agent.py's background thread every 5s, or
the dashboard's client-side heartbeat keeper for DASHBOARD workers.
requeued jobs re-enter Job - QUEUED, picked up by the next tick
Persistence - PostgreSQL (SQLite for local dev on job/node/event repositories)
Event history - every transition persisted at the point it happens
JobCreated . JobScheduled . WorkerAssigned . LeaseAcquired . LeaseReleased . JobCompleted/Failed/Cancelled . JobReclaimed
